Process integration and automation

More than 15,000 invoices a month, with each contract's rules.

Cloudfianz built a workflow automating ConsorcioAbierto's monthly billing.

Cloudfianz's work
Billing integration and automation
Connected platforms
HubSpot, AWS and Odoo
Scope
Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay and Colombia

The client

ConsorcioAbierto provides an administrative and financial management platform for condominium administrators. It serves more than 2,000 administrators and 16,000 condominiums, with commercial agreements varying by client and country.

The challenge

Different contracts, manual calculations every month

The company already used Odoo for billing but needed a CRM to manage the sales lifecycle of administrators paying a platform membership.

Each client could have different terms: time-based discounts, periods with different amounts and country-specific details. Applying these rules manually caused billing errors and recurring monthly work.

The HubSpot implementation with Digifianz started with a specific goal: connect membership management with Odoo billing.

The technical decision

An architecture adapted to contract complexity

What we evaluated

The initial approach considered HubSpot's subscriptions module. During implementation, it proved unable to represent all terms in enough detail.

How we solved it

Cloudfianz designed an alternative: represent memberships as deals in HubSpot pipelines and process their rules with AWS Step Functions and Lambda functions. This kept sales information in the CRM while handling custom billing logic beyond its native limits.

The solution

From membership to invoice

The solution takes memberships from HubSpot and generates invoices in Odoo, applying each contract's discounts, periods and terms in Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay and Colombia.

  1. Memberships inside HubSpot

    Each deal records the commercial agreement and its status.

  2. Terms by period

    Line items represent duration and applicable discount, separating the price from the contract's specific terms.

  3. Updated prices

    The process uses HubSpot products to account for monthly updates, including existing agreements.

  4. Billing in Odoo

    The AWS workflow takes this information, applies contract and country rules and generates the corresponding billing.

Organizing the rules was also part of the project.

The project took a year and a half end to end. Beyond development, it required organizing and documenting discount and billing criteria previously applied manually. Standardizing these rules was central to the solution.

The results

More than 15,000monthly invoices

In just hours

Billing at scale with consistent rules

With memberships entered and updated in HubSpot, the process generates more than 15,000 monthly invoices in Odoo in hours, without the team calculating and entering each invoice separately.

The operational change delivers three concrete capabilities:

  • One workflow for four countries

    The automation accounts for the specifics of Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay and Colombia.

  • Contracts with variable terms

    Discounts and periods are processed according to each membership's defined rules.

  • Less manual calculation and entry

    The team maintains agreements in the CRM and the workflow handles invoice generation.

Standardization reduces reliance on individual judgment when applying agreements.
